entities.name: Mamuka of Imereti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mamuka was a member of the Bagrationi dynasty of Imereti, a kingdom in western Georgia. He was installed as a rival king to his brother, Alexander V of Imereti from 1746 until being deposed in 1749.
